$comment: Perform mode chrome: chart toolbar, song navigation, metronome, keep-awake, live-director sheet, tonight swap, rehearsal audio, offline save. Musical key names, chord symbols and BPM stay verbatim and are never translated.

toolbar.transposeUnavailableImage: Transposing isn't available for image charts. Re-upload as a PDF or MusicXML to change keys.

keepAwake.osWarningTitle: This iPad can't be kept awake from the Home-Screen app.
keepAwake.osWarningBody: iPadOS before 18.4 ignores the screen wake lock in installed web apps. Set Settings → Display & Brightness → Auto-Lock → Never for the service.
keepAwake.screenMaySleep: Screen may sleep — tap to keep awake
keepAwake.errorHidden: Tab not focused — tap chart to retry
keepAwake.errorDenied: Wake-lock blocked — tap again to retry
keepAwake.lockOnAria: Screen lock on — tap to release
keepAwake.unavailableAria: Keep screen on — wake-lock unavailable on this device
keepAwake.unavailableTitle: Wake-lock unavailable on this device (needs iOS 16.4+ or a modern browser)

liveDirector.changeKeyDescription: Update the displayed key for this row
liveDirector.swapChartDescription: Bond this row to a different chart
liveDirector.insertNewSongDescription: Add a song before, after, or at the end
liveDirector.tapKeyToCommit: Tap a key to commit. The displayed key updates everywhere this setlist is open.
liveDirector.libraryLoading: Library hasn't finished loading. Try again in a moment.

tonight.title: Swap for tonight
tonight.staleChanged: Another leader just changed this row to {chartTitle}. Pick again.
tonight.swapFailed: Couldn't swap — check the connection and try again. The plan is still showing.
tonight.alsoSaveHint: Off: tonight only; the saved setlist stays as planned.

overlay.unknownTitle: Can't render this file type yet
overlay.unknownBody: The chart bonded to {songName} isn't a recognized format. Try re-binding it from the library, or open the original file directly.

saveOffline.savingAria: Saving charts for offline use, {progress} of {total}
saveOffline.allSavedAria: All charts saved for offline use
saveOffline.partialAria: {ready} of {total} charts saved offline — tap to save the rest
saveOffline.idleAria: Save all charts for offline use
